questions.stem_text: The left cerebral hemisphere is specialized for which of the following functions?

options.C: verbal, mathematical, and recognizing emotional expressions
options.E: spatial, musical, and recognizing emotional expressions

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - analytic, spatial, and verbal

questions.stem_text: Within the context of sexual harassment, "quid pro quo" refers to:

options.B: the act of exchanging sexual favors for monetary rewards.
options.C: "the judgment of a ""reasonable woman"" that an act is offensive. "
options.D: the judgment of a "reasonable man" that an act is offensive.
options.E: a situation where an employee makes sexual demands to their supervisor.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - overt (explicit) sexual conduct.

questions.stem_text:
Research suggests children's successful adjustment to the divorce of their parents is most
related to:

options.A: the quality of the parent-child relationships prior to the divorce.
options.B: the degree of post-divorce conflict between the parents.
options.C: the child's academic performance prior to the divorce.
options.D: the frequency of contact with the noncustodial parent.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - the degree of post-divorce conflict between the parents.

questions.stem_text: Kohler's studies with apes are seen as demonstrating

options.A: that apes are able to use objects from their natural environment as tools.
options.B: that apes can learn through operant conditioning.
options.C: that learning can occur via insight.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - that learning can occur via insight.

questions.stem_text: A classically conditioned response can best be eliminated by presentation of

options.A: the unconditioned stimulus a few seconds before the conditioned stimulus
options.C: both the conditioned and unconditioned stimulus simultaneously
options.D: a neutral stimulus immediately after the unconditioned stimulus
options.E: the unconditioned stimulus without a neutral stimulus

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the unconditioned stimulus a few seconds before the conditioned stimulus
